project_code.label: Project code
project_code.help: Primary identity and readings-table prefix; TEST is reserved and suppresses ops pages (INV-WBGT-11).

company.label: Company
company.help: Operator-facing identity only; no WBGT runtime path reads it.

enabled.label: Project enabled
enabled.help: Master load gate applied by every job.

instance_name.label: WhatsApp instance
instance_name.help: Listener instance; falls back to client_id when blank.

client_id.label: Client ID
client_id.help: Sending-account identifier required for live delivery.

whatsapp_group_id.label: WhatsApp groups
whatsapp_group_id.help: Comma-separated destinations; job log rows retain only the first group even when several are sent (INV-WBGT-12).

lambda_url.label: Send-message URL
lambda_url.help: Message proxy URL required for live delivery; POC mentions need a /send-message suffix (INV-WBGT-13).

enable_hourly.label: Hourly reports
enable_hourly.help: Loads the project into the hourly job and therefore gates both :00 and sub-hour reports (INV-WBGT-01).

enable_scrape.label: NoiseLynx scraping
enable_scrape.help: Enables around-the-clock scraping; site hours never gate scraping (INV-WBGT-06).

enable_intermittent_reports.label: Intermittent reports
enable_intermittent_reports.help: Allows :15/:30/:45 reports only when enable_hourly also loads the project (INV-WBGT-01).

intermittent_reports_formatter.label: Intermittent cadence
intermittent_reports_formatter.help: Selects red15 or red30 cadence; null is interpreted as red15, not off.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.help: Recorded per project; current gates compute Singapore time directly, so changing it does not move site hours.

site_hours_start.label: Site-hours start
site_hours_start.help: First notification hour, inclusive, in Singapore time.

site_hours_end.label: Site-hours end
site_hours_end.help: Last notification hour, exclusive; 18 means 17:00 is the last hour.

skip_lunch_hour.label: Skip lunch hour
skip_lunch_hour.help: Drops 12:00–12:59; any value other than literal false is treated as enabled.

monthly_sheet_template_id.label: Monthly template workbook
monthly_sheet_template_id.help: Reserved for future template copying and currently read by no runtime path.

monthly_sheet_id.label: Monthly monitoring workbook
monthly_sheet_id.help: Receives monitoring records and, when enabled, the Water Parade Log projection.

monthly_sheet_fill_mode.label: Monthly fill mode
monthly_sheet_fill_mode.help: window uses ±15 minutes; nearest maps sparse manual readings to the nearest tracked hour within 30 minutes.

debug_google_sheet_id.label: Debug workbook
debug_google_sheet_id.help: Optional diagnostic sink for cron, message, and scrape logs.

source_type.label: Login profile
source_type.help: Selects the NoiseLynx credential/browser profile, not the source gate.

telegram_chat_ids.label: Telegram photo chats
telegram_chat_ids.help: Chats permitted to submit meter photos; one enabled project per source chat is enforced (INV-WBGT-14).

telegram_manual_sensor_label.label: Telegram sensor override
telegram_manual_sensor_label.help: Legacy Telegram Bot photo sensor override; new channel flows derive labels automatically.

whatsapp_wbgt_source_chat_ids.label: WhatsApp photo chats
whatsapp_wbgt_source_chat_ids.help: WhatsApp groups permitted to submit meter photos; one enabled project per source chat is enforced (INV-WBGT-14).

whatsapp_manual_sensor_label.label: WhatsApp photo sensor
whatsapp_manual_sensor_label.help: Sensor label assigned to accepted WhatsApp meter photos.

silence_green_alerts.label: Silence green alerts
silence_green_alerts.help: Suppresses low/recovery delivery only after state is persisted (INV-WBGT-10).

hourly_message_formatter.label: Hourly message format
hourly_message_formatter.help: Selects the hourly advisory renderer; unknown runtime values fall back to wohhup_full.

five_min_alert_formatter.label: 5-minute message format
five_min_alert_formatter.help: Chooses short or full rendering without changing the edge-triggered alert decision.

five_min_alert_threshold.label: 5-minute minimum severity
five_min_alert_threshold.help: Minimum upward edge that sends; null preserves the orange default and filtered crossings still persist state (INV-WBGT-04).

exclude_wohhup_from_manpower.label: Exclude Woh Hup from manpower
exclude_wohhup_from_manpower.help: Controls roster and manpower-sheet POC resolution; true preserves the historical exclusion.

remove_sunday_notifications.label: Mute Sundays
remove_sunday_notifications.help: Suppresses WhatsApp only; scraping, storage, and sheet projection continue (INV-WBGT-08).

remove_ph_notifications.label: Mute public holidays
remove_ph_notifications.help: Suppresses WhatsApp only and relies on a hardcoded holiday list requiring maintenance (INV-WBGT-07, INV-WBGT-08).

enable_5min_alerts.label: 5-minute alerts
enable_5min_alerts.help: Enables the independent edge-triggered exceedance job; the first evaluation is always silent (INV-WBGT-05).

top_of_hour_band.label: Top-of-hour band
top_of_hour_band.help: Job-owned state used by sub-hour cadence decisions; editing it changes the next fire (INV-WBGT-02).

last_5min_alert_level.label: Last 5-minute zone
last_5min_alert_level.help: Job-owned edge-detection state; clearing it re-arms a silent first evaluation (INV-WBGT-05).

last_5min_alert_at.label: Last 5-minute state time
last_5min_alert_at.help: Timestamp written when the 5-minute zone state is recorded.

whatsapp_authoritative_client_identifier.label: Authoritative listener client
whatsapp_authoritative_client_identifier.help: Optional 8–15 digit listener identity for deterministic dedup; null deliberately fails open to first arrival.

poc_phone_numbers.label: POC phone numbers
poc_phone_numbers.help: Comma-separated international digits or the standalone manpower-sheet token; mixing forms disables mentions (INV-WBGT-13).

poc_alert_wa_groups.label: POC mention groups
poc_alert_wa_groups.help: Fail-closed allowlist of delivery groups that may receive mentions (INV-WBGT-13).

enable_red_band_poc_mentions.label: POC mentions
enable_red_band_poc_mentions.help: Enables mentions only when the minimum band, valid numbers, and per-group allowlist also match (INV-WBGT-13).

poc_alert_minimum_band.label: POC mention minimum band
poc_alert_minimum_band.help: Inclusive minimum band for POC mentions.

water_parade_enabled.label: Water Parade projections
water_parade_enabled.help: Gates reminders and sheet projection, not cycle/event capture (INV-WBGT-15).

water_parade_outbound_group_id.label: Water Parade groups
water_parade_outbound_group_id.help: Comma-separated reminder destinations; each gets an independent delivery and audit row.

manpower_spreadsheet_id.label: Manpower workbook
manpower_spreadsheet_id.help: Roster and PIC-phone source for Water Parade and manpower-sheet mentions.

water_parade_cooldown_enabled.label: Water Parade cooldown
water_parade_cooldown_enabled.help: Suppresses a new cycle when either of the prior two same-day hour bands already has one.

water_parade_daily_summary_enabled.label: Daily Water Parade summary
water_parade_daily_summary_enabled.help: Enables the daily missed-company summary; Water Parade projections must also be enabled.

water_parade_daily_summary_hour.label: Daily summary hour
water_parade_daily_summary_hour.help: Singapore local hour, 0–23, at which the daily summary is sent.

include_missed_timings_wp.label: Include missed timings
include_missed_timings_wp.help: Includes missed cycle hours in the daily summary when true; false keeps only conducted/total counts.

enable_external_telegram_alerts.label: External Telegram alerts
enable_external_telegram_alerts.help: Allows authenticated external Telegram text alerts to send; parsed readings are still stored when false.

updated_at.label: Updated at
updated_at.help: Bookkeeping timestamp; no general trigger refreshes it automatically.

constraints.name: wbgt_project_configs_intermittent_reports_formatter_check
constraints.help: Intermittent formatter is null, red15, or red30.

constraints.name: wbgt_project_configs_authoritative_client_digits
constraints.help: Authoritative client identity is null or 8–15 bare digits.

constraints.name: wbgt_project_configs_poc_alert_minimum_band_check
constraints.help: POC minimum band is yellow, orange, or red.

constraints.name: wbgt_project_configs_monthly_sheet_fill_mode_check
constraints.help: Monthly sheet fill mode is window or nearest.

constraints.name: wbgt_project_configs_water_parade_daily_summary_hour_check
constraints.help: Daily Water Parade summary hour is between 0 and 23.

constraints.name: wbgt_project_configs_unique_source_chats
constraints.help: An enabled photo source chat belongs to at most one enabled project.
